newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahraini court jails 10 for arson, sabotage.
newsitem.headline: Bahraini court jails 10 for arson, sabotage.

text.p: Bahrain's state security court has jailed 10 people for terms ranging from six months to three years on charges of arson attacks and sabotage in connection to anti-government protests.
Bahraini newspapers said on Sunday the court sentenced four suspects to a three-year jail term each, two for two years each and four for six months each.
Three of the suspects were also fined 200 dinars ($530) each and one was fined 420 dinars for damage to public installations.
The newspapers said the court, whose ruling cannot be appealed, acquitted two suspects.

The court has sentenced around 166 people since Bahrain's government, seeking to speed up judgements, ordered it in March to try hundreds of detainees held for street protests, sabotage and arson attacks.
At least 27 people, including three policemen and seven Bangladeshis, have died since the protests began in Bahrain in December 1994 by majority Shi'ite Moslems demanding political reforms.
